summary: Conviction under IPC s.366-A challenged; victim's age disputed (17 years claimed vs medical opinion 16-17 years); no evidence of sexual intent or force; inconsistencies in victim's testimony regarding prior relationship, escape details, and abduction narrative; consent inferred from victim's failure to raise alarm; absence of seizure documentation for jeep; hostile witnesses; marriage proposal not constituting illicit intercourse; minor status unproven due to lack of birth certificate; appeal allowed due to insufficient evidence meeting criminal standard.
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; conviction and sentence under IPC s.366-A set aside; appellant acquitted.
